name: vizier
description: Shows how to visualize a table — ranked forms drawn from the real rows, with honesty notes — and critiques finished charts against documented patterns.

interface.shortDescription: Show data well; critique charts with evidence
interface.longDescription: Show how to visualize a table: ranked forms drawn from the real rows as offline SVG/HTML or a Datawrapper chart, with newsroom-style honesty notes attached; critique finished graphics against a documented pattern library.
defaultPrompt: Use Vizier to explore this table.
Use Vizier to show this table.
Use Vizier to choose a chart for this question.
Use Vizier to critique this chart for misleading choices.
Use Vizier to check this chart's comparison and denominator.
